summary.en: The ground drifts from a linear to a radial to a conic gradient, each kind moving its own parameters, with narrow cross-fades between kinds.
summary.zh: 底色在线性、径向、锥形三种渐变间缓慢漂移，每种只动自己的参数（角度、圆心与半径、起始角），换种类时窄窗交叉淡化。

fits: An ambient ground under a title sequence or a launch intro; three phases a three-line title can follow.
notFor: Behind dense content (it competes); looks with a flat or paper ground; a cut on the beat (it is slow by design).

intent.en: Keeps a still layout alive: a slow, ever-moving ground gives text-only passages a quiet pulse without pulling the eye.
intent.zh: 让静止排版“活着”：缓慢变化的底色给纯文字段落一层安静的生气，又不抢视线。

content.en: No material: it is the ground under a scene (titles, a wordmark); 1–3 short foreground lines laid over it with `over`, one per gradient phase.
content.zh: 不吃物料：它是一场的底色（标题、字标在上面）；前景 1–3 行短句经 `over` 叠上，可每种渐变配一行。

fits.zh: 片头或发布开场的氛围底；三段渐变正好托住三行标题。

notFor.zh: 密集内容的背后（会抢）；平底或纸面风格；卡点硬切（它故意慢）。

pairs.note: a line of title per gradient phase
one word held over the drifting ground

en: Darken the text side (it does by default); the conic phase's bright tones otherwise eat the foreground's contrast.
Three tones from the look only; a rainbow ring reads as a show, not a brand.
zh: 文字一侧要压暗（默认已做）；否则锥形段的亮色会吃掉前景对比。
只用风格里的三个色调；七彩色环像演出，不像品牌。

upstream.name: 渐变参数变奏
upstream.summary: 背景在 linear、radial、conic 三类 CSS 渐变间平滑过渡——角度、色标、中心、半径逐参数插值，段间交叉淡化换类型
upstream.use: 氛围底/章节底色的连续变奏；给静态排版段落提供"活着"的背景层
upstream.energy: 低（纯背景运动，为前景内容让路）
